prompt: Photo header for a destination page.
shortDesc: Destination header: full-width photo (from GetDestination wikipedia.image) with the place name in large type, country with flag, live local time and region.

props.name: image-url
props.description: Photo URL (GetDestination → wikipedia.image). A sea-and-sky gradient is shown without one.

props.name: timezone
props.description: IANA timezone (GetDestination → place.timezone); shows the live local time.

styling.tailwindClasses: relative grid content-end min-h-[260px] p-6 text-white
styling.notes: Dark harbour gradient over the photo for legibility; 64px Bricolage Grotesque place name; translucent white chips.
